title: Offset Landing and Access-Tower Court
description: One static spacebase landing-service court assembled from two complete qualified original facilities: a broad octagonal well-and-outlet landing platform on the left and a separate fixed caged access-lift tower offset to the rear-right. The landing ramp reaches a ground-level dogleg band aimed toward the tower front, while the front low outlet faces a separate empty apron. The tower keeps its original fixed elevated car and forward trough, at a different height from the landing field: these are deliberately not claimed to be a connected upper bridge or a compatible docking system. All original meshes, directed triangles, normal buffers, internal node transforms and material dictionaries remain intact at unit scale and unchanged pose. A low scene-only connected floor with same-surface path materials is the only new geometry. This landing-field / lower-outlet clearance / offset service-access relation differs from the earlier junction with solar array and sampling rover forecourt. One scene, zero new independent models, two complete instances of two accepted models. No new leg, ramp, tower, vehicle, solar array or repeated prop is counted. Static art only: no real landing, exhaust clearance, evacuation, boarding accessibility, docking compatibility, elevator function, loading, thermal behaviour, navigation, operational workflow, engineering or safety claim.
